VBO:0201318.summary: Lively and sensitive, the Swiss Hound combines a strong attachment to its handler with a determined hunting spirit. It follows scent with its nose close to the ground, working independently and giving voice along the trail. It can be a pleasant companion at home, though endurance and persistence remain hallmarks of its traditional hare and deer hunting work.
VBO:0201318.shortDescription: A sensitive, determined scent hunter, the Swiss Hound works with its nose low and stays closely attached to its handler.

sources.title: FCI Standard59 — Swiss Hound
sources.evidence: Actual Utilization and Behaviour/Temperament paragraphs read: hunts independently giving tongue, determination on difficult terrain, lively passionate hunting, sensitive docile attachment to handler. Four-variety class explicit. Complete normative head, ears, neck, body, limbs, coat, color and intact tail paragraphs read.

sources.title: Schweizerischer Laufhundclub — Der Laufhund
sources.evidence: Actual Verhalten und Einsatz als Jagdhund paragraphs read: folgsam/sehr an Führer gebunden, netter Gefährte at home; traditional low-nosed scent-trailing, flushing and loud chase. Endurance and fine nose. Hare and deer preferred. Temperament is shared across the four varieties; no separate variety trait claimed.
